source: Core Banking · Lending System · Historical Deposit Patterns · Finance & ALM Workbook
unit_note: Loan-to-share ratio, percent. The shaded band is the seasonality range around the with-campaign path.
crossing_label: Baseline reaches the ceiling early in Q1 2027

options.title: Education-Community Deposit Campaign
options.description: Targeted share-gathering across the education field of membership and the newly merged Howard University members, timed to land ahead of the fall payroll-cycle inflow window.
options.projected_impact: Holds the ratio roughly flat through Q4

options.title: Standby Funding Line
options.description: A committed facility held in reserve. Immediate certainty and a hard buffer, but it is purchased liquidity and it does not move the underlying trend.
options.projected_impact: Buffer available on demand; trend unchanged

options.title: Campaign Paired with a Standby Line
options.description: The campaign moves the trend while the line holds the buffer through Q1 in case uptake lands at the low edge of the seasonality band.
options.projected_impact: Ratio held flat and a buffer retained through Q1

closing_note: These options are not mutually exclusive. The recommended path pairs the education-community deposit campaign with a standby funding line to close the gap now and hold a buffer through Q1.
